name: past-limit
what: A lead is still working past the task time limit in settings.

name: ci-red-default
what: The newest decisive CI run of a workflow on the default branch did not succeed.

name: dispatcher-missing
what: Tasks are live but there is not exactly one unfinished session named as the dispatcher.

name: quiet
what: A working lead has written no transcript line and made no commit for more than the threshold, in minutes.

name: ended-undeclared
what: A lead's session ended without it declaring a hand-over or a block, and nothing has happened for more than the threshold, in minutes.

name: blocked-unanswered
what: A lead declared itself blocked more than the threshold, in minutes, ago and is still blocked.

name: handover-unacknowledged
what: A lead handed its work over more than the threshold, in hours, ago and nobody has acknowledged it.

name: review-loops
what: A task has had at least the threshold number of reviewer dispatches since it started.

name: wrong-model
what: A subagent or lead ran on a model other than the one pinned for its role.

name: ci-red-handover
what: A task handed over a pull request that has a failing check.

name: deep-stack
what: A task is stacked on a chain of other tasks longer than the threshold.

name: merged-not-cleaned
what: A task's pull request was merged, or the task was settled, more than the threshold, in hours, ago and it has not been cleaned.
